name: 300 Montgomery Street
note: Pre-war stone office block: colonnaded corner base, punched masonry shaft, heavy cornice, flat parapet. From photos way-944039725-02.jpg and -03.jpg.

name: 550 California Street
note: Tan ashlar tower with arched storefront entries at street level and plain punched windows above. From photos way-243794014-03.jpg and -05.jpg; -01/-02 show the neighbouring round-cornered curtain tower instead and were not used.

name: (no address)
note: Dark modern curtain tower, black vertical fin mullions over tinted glass, Chase bank at ground floor. From photos way-256067734-01.jpg and -03.jpg.

name: Institute of Contemporary Art San Francisco
note: Low glass pavilion with dark bronze stone piers framing a recessed curtain wall. From photos way-288511103-01.jpg and -03.jpg (both agree); -02.jpg is a different building (Monte's Bar) and was not used. Height overridden down from OSM's 30 m: the photos show a squat 3-4 storey pavilion, clearly shorter than its stone neighbours, not a 30 m building.

name: Alvinza Hayward Building
note: Narrow dark grey stone office tower, punched windows, ornate bracketed cornice/parapet. From photo way-690663633-02.jpg (clearest view of the upper storeys and crown); -01.jpg and -03.jpg agree on colour and rhythm but are partly occluded.
